stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.4.0 improves Czech cover-letter handling on Jobs.cz and similar forms. It can safely reveal optional cover/motivation/message fields only from explicit cover-letter controls, supports textarea and rich-text editors with stricter semantic matching, and adds Show/Copy cover-letter actions in Dashboard. Final employer Submit remains manual.
